conviction_note: Near-balanced: sell-side Q3 comp consensus (-8.8%) looks stale against peer evidence that the cyclospora hit faded by end-August (CMG) and was ~150bp for CAVA, and FY guide math points to a raise; but the buy-side whisper (-5% to -8%), a +60% run since the August cut, October PT hikes and upside-paid skew already lean that way, CAVA flagged post-Labor-Day gas-price pressure and fell ~11% today, and SG has fallen on 5 of 7 prints, so p_up sits at 52 on a 13.5% absolute move; the findings sum (+1.25) is larger than the scaled number because the scaled number carries the sign uncertainty and the findings do not.
bar: Revenue Q3 2026 consensus ~$168.7-169.6M (Benzinga $168.7M https://www.benzinga.com/quote/SG/earnings-forecasts ; EarningsWhispers $169.57M https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/SG ; Yahoo $168.79M https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/SG/analysis/ ; GuruFocus $169.42M https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9169494/earnings-to-watch-sweetgreen-inc-sg-q3-2026-gf-value-sees-27-upside ; FXEmpire outlier $173.99M), i.e. about -2% y/y vs $172.4M; EPS -$0.25 to -$0.28. Q3 same-store sales consensus -8.8% and buy-side expectations -8% to -5%, FY2026 SSS consensus -7.3% vs company guide -8% to -7% -- these comp bars rest on ONE source (UBS note as reported by Investing.com 2026-10-28, https://za.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/ubs-raises-sweetgreen-stock-price-target-to-11-on-recovery-outlook-93CH-4532181), so comp-dependent findings are capped small. Company FY2026 guide (2026-08-06 8-K): SSS -8% to -7%, RLM 10.5-11.0%, adj. EBITDA $(27)-(23)M, ~13 net new units; Q3 assumed a 600-700bp outbreak hit.
positioning_check: Short interest 24.10M shares, 23.32% of float, 4.77 days to cover, down from 25.37M prior month (stockanalysis.com statistics page read 2026-11-05, settlement date not stated: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/sg/statistics/); sweep row: 23.17%/7.57 DTC Fintel 2026-09-08. Long side crowded too: Millennium 5.4% (13G/A, event 2026-09-29), D.E. Shaw 5.1% incl. call options (13G, event 2026-10-08), Baillie Gifford 7.96% (13G/A, event 2026-09-30). Options: 25d skew -3.97 vol pts (upside paid), put/call OI 0.10, straddle 13.49%. Stock -7.7% intraday on 2026-11-05 (CAVA sympathy), +14.3% over 20 sessions, +133% off the 52w low.

findings.finding: Sell-side Q3 same-store-sales consensus of -8.8% (revenue ~$169M, -2% y/y) bakes in roughly the full 600-700bp outbreak hit the company guided for the whole quarter, while direct counterparties that reported after Sweetgreen last spoke show the cyclospora drag faded fast: Chipotle (10-28) said its July low-single-digit headwind was gone by end of August, and CAVA (11-04) put the whole-quarter cyclospora/fresh-produce hit at only ~150bp; Sweetgreen itself was cleared by health officials on 07-17, comps were positive the first 10 days of July, and the CDC declared the outbreak over 09-11 -- so a Q3 comp nearer -6% than -8.8% is the likely print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 comp -6.2% vs ~-4% estimate with a guide cut: -8.0%; Q1 2026 comp -12.8% (record decline): +1.9%; Q3 2025 comp -9.5% vs -6.4% estimate: -7.5%. The name has not shown it pays for a comp beat on its own; the guide has decided the prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the buy-side whisper is already -8% to -5% and the stock is ~+60% off its early-September level, so the edge is only against the stale sell-side -8.8%; if the market were fully at the peer read, sell-side revenue would sit near $172M rather than $169M.
findings.independence: Chipotle Q3 2026 release 2026-10-28 (headwind normalised by end-August): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001058090/000105809026000103/cmg-20261028xex991.htm ; CAVA Q3 2026 release 2026-11-04 (~150bp cyclospora hit, FY SRS raised to 6-7%): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001639438/000162828026070159/earningsrelease2026q3.htm ; CDC end-of-outbreak 09-11 per https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/10/01/sweetgreen-is-up-32-since-the-cyclospora-outbreak-ended-is-there-more-room-to-run/

findings.finding: The FY2026 SSS guide of -8% to -7% looks too low on its own arithmetic: with Q1 -12.8% and Q2 -6.2%, a Q3 near -6% and a flat-to-positive Q4 (lapping an easy 2025 base, UBS expects Q4 comps could turn positive) gives a year near -6%, above the top of the range; UBS models FY -6.1% vs consensus -7.3%, so a raised or firmed FY comp guide is the likely release item, with the Molly Baz chef-in-residence LTO (from 09-29) as Q4-to-date support.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance has decided this name's prints: the 2026-08-06 guide cut (-2/-4% to -7/-8%) drew -8.0%; the 2025-08-07 guide cut drew -23.1%; no recent guide raise in the baseline to measure the upside response.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: October PT raises (UBS $6.50->$11, KeyBanc $9->$12, TD Cowen $6->$9, BofA $9.10->$10, MS $7->$8) and the run show the market leans to a raise; what is not priced is its size -- FY comp consensus still at -7.3%, inside the old guide, so a raise to around -6% would move the bar.
findings.independence: UBS note 2026-10-28 (FY -6.1% vs consensus -7.3%, Q4 comps could turn positive): https://za.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/ubs-raises-sweetgreen-stock-price-target-to-11-on-recovery-outlook-93CH-4532181 ; Fool 2026-10-01 (Molly Baz LTO, loyalty change rolled off): https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/10/01/sweetgreen-is-up-32-since-the-cyclospora-outbreak-ended-is-there-more-room-to-run/ . Shares the UBS document with finding 1 (different line: FY guide vs Q3 print).

findings.finding: CAVA, the closest peer, reported 11-04 a Q3 SRS miss (3.1% vs 3.3% Street), cut the top of its RLM and EBITDA ranges, and its CEO blamed fresh-produce concerns and a post-Labor-Day traffic slowdown as gas prices spiked; CAVA fell ~10-11% on 11-05 -- a macro read that late-Q3 and Q4-to-date fast-casual traffic softened, which could cap how far Sweetgreen raises its guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of a peer macro read in the baseline; SG traded -7.7% intraday on 11-05 alongside CAVA, so the market already moves SG on CAVA.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced today: SG is -7.7% intraday (stockanalysis 2026-11-05 13:19 ET) on the CAVA print, so the residual is only whether Sweetgreen's own Q4-to-date commentary confirms the gas-price softness; a crowded 23% short shrinks this negative.
findings.independence: CAVA earnings coverage 2026-11-05 (miss, -11.2%): https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/cava-nyse-cava-misses-q3-221232615.html ; CAVA 8-K 2026-11-04: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001639438/000162828026070159/earningsrelease2026q3.htm (same company document set as finding 1's CAVA independence -- the two use different parts: the 150bp cyclospora figure vs the post-Labor-Day/gas-price commentary). Proxy, not Sweetgreen's own number.

findings.finding: Positioning is crowded both ways into the print: 23.3% of float short (24.1M shares, 4.8 days to cover) against new passive stakes from multi-strategy funds (Millennium 5.4%, D.E. Shaw 5.1% partly via call options, Baillie Gifford 8.0%) and a call-heavy chain (put/call OI 0.10, upside-paid skew); a beat-and-raise meets a short that must cover, a held guide meets pod longs and call holders that exit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Short interest has sat in the low-to-mid 20s% of float through the 2025-2026 prints, during which 5 of 7 reactions were negative, so the short has not squeezed on prints so far.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is visible, not hidden; it is filed as the mechanism that amplifies whichever way the guide goes. The slight positive tilt reflects that the short is still 23% after a 60% rally (shares short only down ~5% m/m) while longs are recent 13G filers.

findings.finding: Margin is the line the beat may not carry: Q2 restaurant-level margin fell ~600bp to 13.1% on portion increases (chicken/tofu) and higher ingredient usage, the FY RLM guide is only 10.5-11.0% and adj. EBITDA $(27)-(23)M implies an H2 loss of $15-19M after H1's $(8.3)M; SG has missed consensus EPS in each of the last four quarters by 42-121%, and CAVA just cited labour, delivery and repair-cost margin pressure.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 EPS -0.22 vs -0.10 est with RLM -600bp: -8.0% (combined with guide cut); repeated EPS misses accompanied most of the 5 negative reactions.
findings.why_not_priced: The bull case in October PT notes is comp-led (UBS EBITDA -$25.2M ~ consensus -$25.3M), so margin is not where the whisper sits above consensus; a comp beat with no EBITDA beat would read as low-quality.

findings.finding: The Sept-29 Molly Baz chef-in-residence six-week LTO, a new menu launch around 09-08 and the roll-off of the 2025 loyalty-program change give management a concrete Q4-to-date traffic story to quote on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Wraps launch (H1 2026) drove the Q2 comp improvement and the May +45% rally, but the print reaction to Q1 was only +1.9%.
findings.why_not_priced: Public marketing news; small, filed for the judges because it bears on the Q4-to-date commentary that decides the guide.

findings.finding: Sweetgreen holds $86.4M of Wonder Group Series C preferred from the Spyce sale (closed in H1 2026); Wonder closed a $650M Series D at a $9B pre-money valuation on 07-16 (Q3), an observable transaction that could trigger an upward remeasurement gain in Q3 GAAP results under the ASC 321 measurement alternative -- a below-the-line item that could flatter GAAP EPS but not adj. EBITDA.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The $160.6M Spyce gain in H1 did not prevent the -8.0% Q2 reaction; below-the-line items have not moved this stock.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether a remeasurement is booked depends on the security's terms (Series C vs D rights) -- inference, not a company statement; no path to guidance, so sized as a fraction.
